notes.title: Aris Arcanum at PAX West
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45332862/196da2ba5e07fb8faed3747d6ff9c8c64a6b82f5.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Aris Arcanum is at PAX West! Try our demo at Indie.io booth #1115 or here on Steam! If you like it, don't forget to add Aris Arcanum to your wishlists.[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Thanks for supporting us at Gamescom!
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45332862/b1756f8ccd7f738f93823eac578224056115c77b.png"][/img][/p][p]Now, when the Gamescom is wrapped up, we want to say a huge THANK YOU to all the people who tried out Aris Arcanum, gave us feedback and supported our game. We appreciate it immensely! Thanks to you, Gamescom was a blast for us. [/p][p]It wasn't pitch perfect. The PC couldn't handle Aris with the smoothness we hoped for. But despite everything, it was magical for us to see you enjoying Aris Arcanum. We hope to meet you soon again![/p][p]And special thanks to Gamescom and Indie.io for making it happen for us![/p]

notes.title: Gamescom is here!
notes.notes: [p]We brought Aris Arcanum to Gamescom for you to try out! Find our booth #F-011 in Hall 10.2 and try out our freshest demo until August 24th. We’re thrilled to hear your thoughts about our game. [/p][p]If you’re not in Germany, don’t worry, we’ve updated our demo here on Steam so you still get a chance to try out new version! [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45332862/adee2134540a3ea0ddc223ea122649e3f3b84e4d.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: We're bringing Aris Arcanum to PAX West!
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45332862/7c1ce98316b4a72a72344d6267fb41b7ac6022cc.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Aris Arcanum is going to PAX West! We're happy to be celebrating video and tabletop games with you all.[/p][p]If you’re visiting, check out our game at indie.io's booth, Booth #316, and try our demo on the show floor from August 29 to September 1. But worry not, a demo is also available on Steam for you to try at home![/p][p]We’re excited to receive all your feedback on Steam or our Discord. See you at PAX West![/p]

notes.title: Aris Arcanum goes to Gamescom!
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45332862/33122c32ab450be4c28b7cec98434da35a67f8ee.png"][/img][/p][p]Exciting news: our game is making it to Gamescom, the largest video games convention in Europe! In honour of this adventure, we’re releasing a new update for our demo:[/p][list][*][p]New reworked UI of literally everything: spellcrafting, shop, dialogues and HUD;[/p][/*][*][p]Improved and polished environment;[/p][/*][*][p]New music and improved sound design;[/p][/*][*][p]More quality of life improvements, like graphics settings.[/p][/*][/list][p]If you’re coming to Cologne August 20-24, we encourage you to visit our booth and try the game yourself! If you’re not visiting Gamescom, worry not, the updated demo is already on Steam for you to try! [/p][p]We’re excited to receive all your feedback and see you at Gamescom![/p]

notes.title: Feedback Forum
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45332862/5cb75549823f6d5f7695ffc73192b371e86110c7.png"][/img][/p][h1]We want to hear your opinion![/h1][p][/p][p]We want to hear your opinion on Aris Arcanum! Let us know what you think about our spellcrafting, walking cycle, characters or anything memorable to you in our new Feedback Forum. We want all criticism (or praise) you have! After years of working on Aris, we are no longer surprised by our twists or challenged by our enemies. Now we need your, our players’, feedback more than ever before![/p][p][/p][p][url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/3006080/discussions/1/" style="button"]Feedback Forum[/url][/p]

notes.title: Aris Arcanum at Steam Next Fest
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45332862/da6f2be70df0a8acda0cd779eeb92071c7c63ca4.png"][/img][/p][h1]Aris Arcanum at Steam Next Fest[/h1][p]Big news from us: Aris Arcanum is a part of the upcoming Steam Next Fest! You can already try out our demo and tell us what you think! [/p][p]In this demo, we wanted to give you a glimpse of what the beginning of the game feels like: you will meet your first enemies, try to help new friends, and get a glimpse into what happened in the Aris Library. The most skilful of you can also try to defeat our first boss![/p][p]Of course, we have much more to come: more spells, enemies, quests and bosses will await you in the full game. [/p][p]Now you have the chance to influence how the game turns out. Tell us what you liked about it and what you hated. We want to hear it all![/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Welcome to Aris & meet our publisher
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45332862/f61af94dbdc2ef3c9410366743753917117ad675.png[/img]
[h2]Hey there![/h2]
We are so thrilled to share the game we’ve been working on for a long while. Aris Arcanum is born from our love of the gloomy vibes of Yharnam and the beauty of Elysium. Get ready to be lost in the grotesque halls of the endless ever-changing library to find death and beyond in there. 

[h2]Publisher Announcement[/h2]
We are happy to announce that we teamed up with indie.io to let Aris Arcanum reach even more players. These guys helped [url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/indieio]lots of indie games[/url] to shine so we are lucky to have them on board.

For those of you who may not know, working with a game publishing platform like indie.io greatly helps indie developers focus on game development while they handle all the behind-the-scenes magic. From helping manage store pages to crafting marketing campaigns and even helping the game shine at both digital and live events, indie.io helps in all the aspects that indie developers often struggle with alone.

[h2]Wishlist & Subscribe[/h2]
Don’t forget to add Aris Arcanum to your Wishlists! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3006080/Aris_Arcanum/

Follow us on TikTok and join our Discord server to get more updates. See you in Aris!
